# shoal_connection (Data Source)

Look up a connection, for example an org-wide one in `shared`, to read its webhook URL and register it in Jira or GitHub with their own Terraform providers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "shoal_connection" "github" {
  namespace = "shared"
  name      = "github-acme"
}

resource "github_organization_webhook" "shoal" {
  events = ["pull_request", "pull_request_review", "issue_comment"]
  configuration {
    url          = data.shoal_connection.github.webhook_url
    content_type = "json"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Defaults to the provider's namespace; connections in `shared` are found from any namespace.

### Read-Only

- `integration` (String) Integration key, e.g. `github` or `jira`.
- `spec` (Dynamic)
- `webhook_url` (String) URL that receives this connection's webhooks.
